{{Top|leg}}
A '''holoplacard''' was a type of art. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Zyk-yadoon]] created a holoplacard that depicted the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ood Bnar]] during the [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|Battle of Ossus]]. The holoplacard was hung in the [[Museum/Legends|museum]] [[Remembrance Hall]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] and it was destroyed in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], when the musuem was attacked by the [[Believers]].
